svg.title: Referral Arrangements Priced in Settlements and Per-Claim Penalties
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-stark-aks-settlement-exposure-ladder; chapter number: 6; chart type: funnel; title: Referral Arrangements Priced in Settlements and Per-Claim Penalties; subtitle: Dollar figures quoted for Stark and Anti-Kickback exposure, largest to smallest; caption: Wheeling Hospital's net-revenue physician pay settled for $50M with $10M to a former-executive relator; free call coverage at Catholic Medical Center cost $3.8M; per-claim penalties stack on every referral-tainted claim.; assumptions note: Stages are ordered by quoted dollar size rather than a single conversion path; per-claim figures are practitioner-quoted and adjust for inflation over time.; note: Sources: KLGatesLaw (MMcEwUD0PNo), Holland & Hart LLP (wODno0XW8l4), OIGatHHS (Meredith Williams, a4KhqqeAaUg).; stages: label: Wheeling Hospital settlement; value: 50000000; display: $50M; conversion: Motion to dismiss denied before settlement; detail: Physicians paid a percentage of net revenue tracked in physician impact reports (KLGatesLaw).; label: Wheeling relator share; value: 10000000; display: $10M; conversion: Paid to a former-executive relator; detail: Referral spreadsheets tied to pay were the gap; firewall them or stop keeping them (KLGatesLaw).; label: Catholic Medical Center settlement; value: 3800000; display: $3.8M; conversion: Bona fide employee safe harbor did not apply; detail: Free call coverage that other cardiologists were paid $10,000 per weekend to provide (KLGatesLaw).; label: Stark penalty per claim; value: 25820; display: $25,820 per claim; conversion: Adjusted for inflation; can add up really quickly; detail: Exclusion, FCA treble damages, and qui tam suits layer on top (Holland & Hart LLP).; label: FCA kickback penalty per claim; value: 11000; display: $11,000 per claim plus 3x loss; conversion: Civil side of kickback exposure; detail: Up to three times the program's loss plus $11,000 per claim (OIGatHHS, Meredith Williams).

text.title: Referral Arrangements Priced in Settlements and Per-Claim Penalties
text.tspan: Referral Arrangements Priced in Settlements and Per-Claim

circle.title: label: Wheeling Hospital settlement; value: 50000000; display: $50M; conversion: Motion to dismiss denied before settlement; detail: Physicians paid a percentage of net revenue tracked in physician impact reports (KLGatesLaw).

label: Wheeling relator share; value: 10000000; display: $10M; conversion: Paid to a former-executive relator; detail: Referral spreadsheets tied to pay were the gap; firewall them or stop keeping them (KLGatesLaw).

label: Catholic Medical Center settlement; value: 3800000; display: $3.8M; conversion: Bona fide employee safe harbor did not apply; detail: Free call coverage that other cardiologists were paid $10,000 per weekend to provide (KLGatesLaw).

label: Stark penalty per claim; value: 25820; display: $25,820 per claim; conversion: Adjusted for inflation; can add up really quickly; detail: Exclusion, FCA treble damages, and qui tam suits layer on top (Holland & Hart LLP).

label: FCA kickback penalty per claim; value: 11000; display: $11,000 per claim plus 3x loss; conversion: Civil side of kickback exposure; detail: Up to three times the program's loss plus $11,000 per claim (OIGatHHS, Meredith Williams).

text.title: Assumptions: Stages are ordered by quoted dollar size rather than a single conversion path; per-claim figures are practitioner-quoted and adjust for inflation over time.
text.tspan: Assumptions: Stages are ordered by quoted dollar size rather than a single conversion path; per-claim figures are practitioner-quoted
and adjust for inflation over time.
